class.name: OcgGceMakescale
class.brief_description: Implements an elementary construction algorithm for a scaling transformation in 3D space. The result is a gp_Trsf transformation. A MakeScale object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of the transformation, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the result.
